subject: Project update
text:
Dear Professor,

I wanted to share an update on the research project. After adjusting the coding script and reviewing the first set of results, the model performed better than we expected. The error rate fell to nearly half of the earlier estimate, and the output now fits the initial assumptions.

I have saved the revised files in the shared folder. I can prepare a short summary for the next meeting if useful. Thank you again for the guidance and your patience.

Best regards,
